photoc - Command-line tools for photographers.

Usage: photoc [global options] <command> [args]
       photoc <command> --help

Commands:
  review       Cull JPEG and ARW photos in an interactive terminal session
  query        Search photo metadata and print matching paths
  check        Audit JPEG and ARW structural readability
  compress     Re-encode JPEGs by quality or target size
  contact      Generate paged JPEG contact sheets from JPEG and ARW
  exif         Inspect JPEG and Sony ARW metadata
  duplicates   Find exact duplicate files
  stats        Summarize JPEG and Sony ARW collections
  timeline     Summarize shooting dates and sessions
  rename       Preview or apply photo renames
  sort         Preview or apply photo sorting
  focus        Compare JPEG and ARW sharpness scores
  scrub        Remove GPS or descriptive metadata from JPEG and ARW

Global options:
  -h, --help       Show global or command help
  -V, --version    Show the version
  -v, --verbose    Add diagnostics on stderr
  -q, --quiet      Suppress status text and non-critical warnings
      --no-progress  Disable interactive progress display
      --json       Request JSON output where supported

Commands read JPEG and Sony ARW; compress handles JPEG only.
Rename and sort preview by default; compress, scrub, and contact write copies.
Focus scores sharpness as a review aid, not a blur verdict.
Review saves marks separately and never changes photo files.
Run 'photoc <command> --help' for usage and examples.
